title: Lemma 4.8: connectivity and t-exactness for a closed immersion
statement_scope: Let f*:Y→X be a closed immersion of ∞-topoi. Then: (1) f* carries n-connective objects of Y to n-connective objects of X; (2) f* carries n-connective morphisms of Y to n-connective morphisms of X; (3) f* induces a left t-exact functor ShvSp(Y)→ShvSp(X). All three assertions, their reduction to (2) and the induction on n are retained.
